title.en: Take out a short-term bank loan

summary.zh-TW: 向銀行借入 {{money:param.amount}}，一年內要還，列為短期借款。
summary.en: Borrow {{money:param.amount}} from the bank, repayable within a year, recorded as short-term borrowings.

explanation.zh-TW: 借來的錢讓現金增加，但同時多了一筆要還的義務，所以負債也增加，獲利不受影響。它和股東出資不同：借款要還本付息。現金流量表把借入的錢列在籌資活動的短期借款收入。
explanation.en: Borrowed money increases cash, but it also creates an obligation to repay, so liabilities rise and profit is unaffected. Unlike capital from shareholders, a loan must be repaid with interest. The statement of cash flows shows the proceeds under financing activities as proceeds from short-term borrowings.
